method: Every council meeting from 2025-01-14 to 2026-10-13 was read from its summary minutes. Every numbered item was screened; kept items that name or benefit a private party (contracts, purchases, bid waivers, piggybacks, zoning/site plans, leases, land sales, grants, settlements, union contracts, agreements with named private organizations). Excluded proclamations, recognitions, street designations, appointments, budgets/millage, internal staffing, and items whose only parties are governments. Rolls come from the minutes: roll-call absences and named no votes; "unknown" means the recorded tally does not match the members present and the minutes do not say who did not vote. Donors were not consulted.

gaps: Oct 27, 2026 meeting has not happened/has no minutes yet (agenda posted, CHAMP event 631).

Signed resolution scans were not read (they are image-only PDFs); votes come from the summary minutes. Resolution links for 2025-R-1 to 2025-R-216 are not listed on the city page, so those items link to the minutes PDF.

Applicant names for most zoning and site-plan items are not in the minutes; the agenda backup PDFs (Tab attachments) name them but could not be read reliably because the shared browser tab was repeatedly navigated by another session. Only 2025-R-14 was checked (agent of record, unnamed in extract).

Several split votes are recorded without naming the dissenter: 2025-R-14 (4-1), 2025-R-99 (4-1). Several 4-0 votes with five present do not say who did not vote: 2025-R-13, 2025-R-231, 2025-R-233, 2025-R-234, 2026-R-127, 2026-R-128.
Minutes contradictions: 2025-R-161 recorded 5-0 but names Burns and Desulme as no votes; 2025-R-209 recorded 4-0 but names Burns as a no vote.
Settlement amounts for 2026-R-92 and 2026-R-93 are not in the minutes.
Special budget hearings (2025-09-11, 2025-09-25, 2026-09-04, 2026-09-15) and special meetings were read; they held no qualifying private-party actions beyond budget items.
